selection: all exact CREATE subscription-period candidates derived from authoritative order, activation, contract segment and return facts

lock.transactionBoundary: repeatable-read transaction; reload and hash all candidates under locks before inserts

cancellation: cancel before commit; committed-result-unproved requires same-operation reconcile
idempotency: stable source keys make applied CREATE candidates UNCHANGED; replay never inserts another period or audit
checksums: classification digest binds candidate source keys, period bounds, authority snapshots, overlaps, omissions and invariant violations
exitCondition: retire after all supported historical orders have authoritative subscription periods
